lemmas.primary_translation: to flow over the edge / to suddenly and unthinkingly unleash a feeling or reaction

examples.no: bøttene er så fulle at vannet renner over
examples.en: the buckets are so full that the water is overflowing
that was the last straw for me

definitions.text: brått og uoverveid slippe løs følelse, reaksjon eller lignende
definitions.translation: to suddenly and unthinkingly unleash a feeling, reaction, or similar
